description: This file defines classes and objects related to Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) models in Spark MLlib, including local and distributed implementations, with methods for inference, evaluation, and serialization.

classes.name: LDAModel
classes.description: Abstract base class for LDA models, supporting both local and distributed representations.

classes.name: LocalLDAModel
classes.description: Represents a non-distributed, inferred LDA model storing only topics.

classes.name: DistributedLDAModel
classes.description: Represents a distributed LDA model with full training data and topic distributions.

methods.name: vocabSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the vocabulary.

methods.name: docConcentration
methods.description: Returns the Dirichlet prior for document-topic distributions.

methods.name: topicConcentration
methods.description: Returns the Dirichlet prior for topic-term distributions.

methods.name: topicsMatrix
methods.description: Returns the matrix of inferred topics.

methods.name: describeTopics
methods.description: Returns top terms for each topic.

methods.name: logLikelihood
methods.description: Calculates the log likelihood of data given the model.

methods.name: topicDistributions
methods.description: Returns the topic distribution for each document.

methods.name: topicDistribution
methods.description: Returns the topic distribution for a single document.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the model to a specified path.

methods.name: toLocal
methods.description: Converts a distributed model to a local model.
